record.one_liner: Shopify is a commerce platform for merchants to run online and retail stores, with APIs for products, orders, customers, inventory and checkout.
record.auth_notes: Admin API: access token sent in X-Shopify-Access-Token. Tokens come from authorization code grant (standalone apps), token exchange (embedded apps), or client credentials (client secret for your own org's stores, 24h token; client assertion JWT for public apps). Offline tokens are expiring (1h + 90-day refresh token) and are required for apps created on or after Dec 1, 2026. Legacy admin-created custom app tokens (shpat_) can no longer be created, only maintained. Storefront API uses public/private storefront tokens or tokenless access. Customer Account API uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. Partner API uses a token created in Organization settings.
record.access_notes: Create an app in the Dev Dashboard and install it on a development store, or on stores in your own organization via the client credentials grant. Custom distribution needs no review. Public App Store distribution requires approval and a one-time registration fee (amount not stated). I did not confirm from fetched docs that Partner accounts and dev stores are free. This is from general knowledge, not a fetched page. Dev stores are test-only, with test payments only.
record.blocker: Each merchant store must install the app. Public distribution needs App Store approval, and the legacy admin-created custom app route is closed. Tokens are expiring and need refresh handling. Query-cost rate limits apply (about 1000 points max, 50/s restore in the sample). Official MCP servers are for dev docs and storefront/customer use, not Admin API store management.
